voiceover:
[conversational] Stop guessing why your reel flopped. Your own numbers can tell you.

Instagram tracks something called skip rate: the share of views where people bailed in the first 3 seconds.

[playful] One. Wait about 48 hours, then open the Reel and tap View insights. You need a Professional account.

Two. Screenshot the insights and the Retention graph. Copy your hook.

Three. In ChatGPT, tap plus and attach it. Free plan allows 3 uploads a day, so combine screenshots or paste the numbers.

Then type: "Diagnose why it flopped, focusing on the first 3 seconds. Give 3 hook rewrites and a 7-day plan."

[serious] Honest catch: ChatGPT can't watch your video, so treat its answer as a smart guess. And there's no official skip rate pass mark.

[confident] Safest route: screenshots only. Connectors exist, but they're third-party.

Is your hook usually a question or a statement? Tell me below.

Send this to the friend who keeps deleting flopped reels.

topic: Find out why your reel flopped using ChatGPT: paste your Instagram Insights (reach, watch time, saves) and your hook, and get a diagnosis plus a 7-day content plan.

pick.topic: Find out why your reel flopped using ChatGPT: paste your Instagram Insights (reach, watch time, saves) and your hook, and get a diagnosis plus a 7-day content plan.
pick.angle: Stop guessing why your reels flop. Give ChatGPT your real numbers and make it diagnose the first 3 seconds.
pick.why: 552k views, 15.6k likes and 12.9k comments in 3 days (46s), a very high comment rate that shows strong demand from creators and marketers. We can teach the version that works for everyone: copy your own Insights data or screenshots into ChatGPT with a structured prompt, with no special connector needed.

research.tool: ChatGPT (free plan works for screenshot/paste) + Instagram Insights (Professional dashboard → View insights). Optional: a third-party Instagram connector from ChatGPT's Plugin Directory (for example Windsor.ai, Porter Metrics, Supermetrics).
research.availability: ChatGPT: free tier can upload images and files, with limits. Instagram Insights: free, but needs a Professional (Creator or Business) account. Native Insights is in the Instagram app (iOS and Android). Automatic 'connect Instagram' needs a third-party connector, which is not official. Some connectors need a Facebook login, and Meta's API only covers Business/Creator accounts. Custom MCP connectors need Developer Mode (plan-dependent), and the setup is web-only. Availability varies by region.
steps: Instagram app (phone): open your profile and tap 'Professional dashboard', then 'See all insights' or 'Insights'. (Simpler route: Reels tab → open the flopped Reel → tap 'View insights'. One source says tap the three-dot menu → 'View insights' instead.) You need a Professional account, so switch in settings if you don't see it.

On that Reel's insights screen, note: Views, Watch time, Average watch time, Skip rate (the share of views skipped in the first 3 seconds), the Retention chart, Reach/Viewers, and the Saves, Shares, Comments and Likes counts. Take a screenshot of the Reel insights and the retention graph. Also copy the hook (the first spoken line or on-screen text), the Reel length and the caption. Wait about 48 hours after posting so the data is stable.

Open ChatGPT (app or chatgpt.com), start a new chat, and attach the screenshot(s) with the + button. Free accounts are limited to 3 file uploads per day, so combine everything into 1-2 screenshots or just paste the numbers as text.

Paste a prompt along these lines: 'Here are my Reel insights: Views __, Reach __, Watch time __, Avg watch time __, Skip rate __, Saves __, Shares __. Reel length __ sec. My hook (first 3 sec, spoken + on-screen): "__". Diagnose why it flopped, focusing on the first 3 seconds. Give 3 better hook rewrites, then a 7-day Reel content plan with one hook per day.'

Optionally, for the 'connected' version (not official): in ChatGPT, open the Plugin Directory (renamed from the App Directory on 9 July 2026), search for an Instagram analytics connector (for example Windsor.ai, Porter Metrics or Supermetrics) and install it. Sign in through the connector's own flow. This usually means signing in with Facebook and granting Insights access, since there is no sign-in with Instagram directly. Then enable it in the chat via the + menu and ask: 'Pull skip rate and average watch time for my last 15 Reels and tell me what the worst 3 have in common in the first frame.'

Add your own competitor info (public profile or Reel links, pasted as text). ChatGPT cannot see competitors' private analytics. Only some third-party connectors read public competitor posts, and only public numbers such as likes and comments.
facts: ChatGPT plugins were shut down in April 2024: no new plugin conversations after March 19, 2024, and everything went off on April 9, 2024.

Plugins were replaced by GPTs, then apps and connectors. On July 9, 2026 OpenAI replaced the App Directory with the 'Plugin Directory', which holds skills, apps and app templates (dragapp, gradually.ai). The word 'plugin' is back, but the new plugins share only the name with the 2023 ones.
gradually.ai reports that OpenAI plans to retire custom GPTs on December 11, 2026. This is not confirmed by an official OpenAI source here, so treat it as unverified.

There is NO official Instagram/Meta connector in ChatGPT: one vendor wrote that the plugin directory has no Meta/Instagram plugin (searched 20 Oct 2026), and another says OpenAI ships no native Instagram connector. Instagram data comes in through third-party connectors (Windsor.ai, Porter Metrics, Supermetrics, Two Minute Reports, Data Bloo). Windsor says it connects 'Instagram Business or Creator' accounts via the official Graph API and Facebook authentication.
Windsor labels the connector 'Instagram Insights' on its connection screen and 'Instagram Organic' elsewhere. They are the same connector.
Porter's manual route is: + → Connectors → Manage connectors → Add custom connector → name it, paste the MCP URL. Porter also exists as an approved app in the ChatGPT apps gallery.

Developer Mode for custom connectors: sources disagree on which plans get it. One says Pro/Team/Enterprise/Edu, another says Pro/Plus/Enterprise, another says all plans. The path is Settings → Connectors → Advanced → Developer mode, then 'Create' with a name and an MCP server URL. Some UIs show 'Settings → Apps → Create app'. Avoid promising that free users can do this.

Instagram Reel insights show plays/views, accounts reached, likes, comments, shares, saves, watch time, average watch time and follows. Sources describe the in-app path as Reels tab → open the Reel → 'View insights', or Profile → 'Professional dashboard' → 'See all insights'.

Skip rate: Instagram defines it as 'the percentage of views from people who decided to skip your reel during those first 3 seconds' (quoted via Social Media Today). It replaced 'view rate' in Reels insights in August 2025, together with a new 'Retention' chart. Per a 26 April 2026 Insights redesign, skip rate and share rate appear as percentages at the top of each Reel's insights (virallized.com, a secondary source).
Instagram on retention (via Social Media Today): you always see a downward slope, but the flatter the line, the more engaged the audience.

Free ChatGPT upload limits: 20 MB per image, 3 file uploads per day on Free, and 80 files every 3 hours on Go/Plus/Pro (fast.io, citing the OpenAI Help Center, accessed 21 Oct 2026). Older sources say 2 images per day, so the free limit has changed over time.
Instagram's own Insights keep data for roughly 90 days for account-level data, while Reel insights go back further (instapect.com claims up to two years).

Skip rate benchmarks are contested. Retensis says under 20% is strong, 20-30% is healthy and above 40% needs a hook fix. Creatorflow says to keep it under 30%. cut.pro says there is no official benchmark and that the '70% must get past 3 seconds' rule is a myth. Socialinsider's median skip rate is about 60-65% (60.5% to 65.5% depending on follower size), so don't cite a pass/fail number.
do_not_claim: 'Connect ChatGPT to your Instagram' as if it were a built-in or official ChatGPT feature. It isn't. It only works through a third-party connector (Windsor/Porter/Supermetrics etc.).

'Open Plugins in ChatGPT → click Add → type a name → paste this link → Create → Continue → Sign in with Instagram' is not a verified flow. Today the menu is the Plugin Directory (since 9 July 2026) or Settings → Apps/Connectors. The custom connector flow needs Developer Mode and an MCP URL, not an Instagram link. Connectors sign in via Facebook/Meta or the vendor's own account, not a plain 'Sign in with Instagram'. Don't claim a 2-minute setup that works for everyone.

'It reads your account's real data and just tells you the hook was weak' is overstated. ChatGPT can only infer from numbers, screenshots and the hook text you give it. It cannot see the Reel video itself (a connector may pull transcripts or metadata), and it cannot give a guaranteed cause. Its diagnosis is a hypothesis.
'Your views will grow' or 'watch the views go up' is an unverifiable outcome claim.

'See what competitors are posting' via the same connection is only partly true. Native Insights gives no competitor data. Only some connectors read public profile posts (like and comment counts, follower counts), not their reach, saves or watch time.

'Last time Claude setup... now ChatGPT, yes it works' is unverifiable in the form shown. Connectors like Windsor/Porter work on both, but the steps differ (Claude: Settings → Connectors; ChatGPT: Settings → Apps/Connectors or the Plugin Directory).
The 'comment GPT / follow or DM won't come' mechanic is the other creator's lead-gen funnel, a promotion for a lead magnet. The 'setup + exact prompts' are not independently verified.
Don't state the old name 'ChatGPT Plugins' as if it were the 2023 feature. The old plugins were shut down in 2024.
Don't give a skip-rate pass mark (like '70%' or '30%') as official. No official benchmark exists.
criticism: Privacy/security: a connector sends your Instagram Insights data to a third-party company and then into ChatGPT, and you authorize it with a Facebook/Meta login. OpenAI's own help page warns that GPTs integrated with apps and external APIs may send relevant parts of your input to the third party (chatai.guide summarising OpenAI help). The safest route is screenshots or pasted numbers with nothing connected.

Third-party connectors are often paid or freemium. Two Minute Reports and Porter offer free sign-ups or trials, but free usage is limited and prices vary. Data Bloo, Windsor and Supermetrics are commercial products.
Instagram only reports insights for Business/Creator accounts (and public personal accounts get a limited set), and Stories insights can only be pulled within 24 hours (Data Bloo).

Skip rate benchmarks and the '3-second rule' are not officially defined. Socialinsider's data suggests a median skip rate of about 60-65% even for large accounts, so ChatGPT may flag normal numbers as a problem.
Free ChatGPT is limited to 3 uploads a day, so screenshot-heavy analysis may hit the cap.

ui.platforms: iOS and Android (Instagram Insights, the ChatGPT app) plus web (chatgpt.com). Instagram Insights is mobile-first, and the web profile has limited insights. Connector setup (Plugin Directory, Settings → Connectors/Apps, Developer Mode) is best shown on the ChatGPT web app.
apps: ChatGPT (chatgpt.com or the ChatGPT mobile app)
Optional: a connector's sign-in page (Windsor.ai / Porter Metrics / Supermetrics) and the Facebook/Meta authorize screen
screens: Instagram profile screen: your profile has the account name at the top, a row with posts/followers/following, and a 'Professional dashboard' button/card just under the bio. A Reels tab (play-icon) sits in the grid tab row, next to the grid, the tagged tab and similar tabs.

Professional dashboard: shows a card with 'Insights' (a summary of views/reach over the last 30 days), with 'See all insights' or 'See all' on it. Tapping it opens the account-level overview with a date range selector.
Reel view: open a Reel from the Reels tab and a 'View insights' link/button sits below the Reel (some builds show it via the three-dot menu ••• at the bottom-right).

Reel insights screen: at the top the percentages (skip rate, share rate), then a chart of views over time, 'Views', 'Watch time', 'Average watch time', 'Viewers/Reach', 'Follows', and an interactions block ('Likes', 'Comments', 'Shares', 'Saves'). The 'Retention' graph plots how many viewers are still watching at each second, with a steep drop at the start for a weak hook. Menu names have shifted between versions (an 'Insights > Content' view with 'Views', 'Watch time', 'Average watch time', 'Viewers').

ChatGPT (web): a new-chat page with a message box saying 'Ask anything', and a '+' button at the left of the box to attach files or pick an app/connector. The left sidebar has the chat list, with 'Settings' under your profile icon at the bottom-left. In Settings you'll find 'Apps' / 'Connectors' with 'Advanced' → 'Developer mode' (labels vary by release). The Plugin Directory lists plugins/apps and has a search box. Default theme follows the system setting (light or dark).
ChatGPT result: ChatGPT returns a long, structured chat answer: a diagnosis (hook, skip rate, retention) and a day-by-day 7-day plan listing a topic and hook each day. It's text, not charts.

research.visuals: Show (1) the Instagram Reel's 'View insights' screen with Views, Watch time, Skip rate and the Retention graph (a real screen recording is best, since the retention chart and exact labels vary by account); (2) the numbers + hook pasted into ChatGPT (use mock/blurred data); (3) ChatGPT's written diagnosis plus the 7-day plan. If you show the connector route, record the real Plugin Directory / Settings screen, because labels have changed several times.
research.notes: Recommended angle: drop the 'connect ChatGPT to Instagram in 2 minutes' framing. The reliable version of your topic is manual: screenshot or copy your Reel's Insights (Views, Watch time, Average watch time, Skip rate, Retention graph, Saves/Shares), paste in your hook, and ask ChatGPT for a diagnosis plus a 7-day plan. It works on the free plan within upload limits, needs no third-party access, and matches the angle 'give ChatGPT your real numbers'. Skip rate is the best metric for 'the first 3 seconds', and Instagram defines it officially. Mention that the connector route exists, is third-party, and is optional. Terminology changed in 2026: ChatGPT 'apps' were renamed 'plugins' in July 2026 (Plugin Directory), and OpenAI reportedly plans to retire custom GPTs on 11 Dec 2026, so avoid 'GPT store' wording. Note the source quality: most connector and benchmark pages are vendor blogs (not official Meta/OpenAI docs), so keep claims general. I couldn't verify Instagram's official help-page wording directly, so recheck the exact Insights labels on a live account before screen-recording. Ask the writer to keep numbers in the demo as obvious examples, not real benchmarks. The hook should avoid promising growth.
